description: Behavioural evaluation of the LLM commander against fixed world states (reqs 500-521). Regenerate with ai/commander_eval.py against a model server on :11435.

results.probe: states a posture and a strategy
names a concrete main effort when the enemy is located
does not attack a stale last-known position as if it were current
answers observed enemy air with anti-air production
does not put every corps on the main attack
declines or retreats from a fight it is heavily outnumbered in
produces only real OpenRA unit ids
returns a usable plan rather than an empty object

method_note: The prompt was iterated against this probe set, so the score means the model CAN be made to satisfy these behaviours - not that it would on unseen situations. The probes encode the requirements rather than arbitrary preferences, and the hard-rules block is general commander doctrine, but the overfitting risk is real and stated here rather than hidden.
observed_sensitivity: Adding emphasis to the intel and production instructions initially fixed those two probes and regressed the reserve and outnumbered probes, holding the score at 6/8. A 4B model has limited capacity to hold competing instructions; a compact hard-rules block placed last recovered all eight. ai/selfcheck.py pins that block so it cannot silently regress.
